title: Error reduction for randomized languages
statement: Let $E$ be a verifier model that is closed under testing whether any of a polynomial number of consecutive random blocks is accepted. Suppose a language $L$ has an $E$-efficient verifier with polynomially many random bits, perfect rejection on inputs outside $L$, and acceptance probability at least $\min(2/3,(|x|+1)^{-c})$ on each input $x\in L$, for some natural number $c$. Then, for every natural number $d$, $L$ has an $E$-efficient verifier with polynomially many random bits, perfect rejection outside $L$, and acceptance probability at least $1-2^{-((|x|+1)^d+1)}$ on every $x\in L$.
